aboutMissionBody: Bangladesh has thousands of talented football and cricket players playing in union grounds, upazila leagues, and district tournaments. PlayerHaat gives every player a verified sporting identity, match history, and reputation — while helping captains and clubs recruit reliable talent.
contactPageSubtitle: Need help with your profile, verification, or recruitment requests? Reach out to our team in Dhaka.
privacySection1Body: We collect account details (name, phone number, email, birth year, avatar), sport-specific profiles (positions, stats, achievements, media, availability, khep rates), and match ratings.
privacySection2Body: You control your phone visibility in Settings. By default, only signed-in recruiters or captains you accept in a match or invitation can view your phone number.
privacySection3Body: You can permanently delete your account and purge all uploaded photos at any time from Settings or via our Account Deletion page.
termsSection1Body: When a player accepts a match or khep request, captains rely on them. Confirmed no-shows are recorded on your profile.
termsSection2Body: Players and recruiters must provide accurate information. Submitted verification documents are reviewed by moderators.
termsSection3Body: Harassment, fake profiles, spam, or payment scams result in immediate account suspension.
accountDeletionPageSubtitle: How to permanently delete your PlayerHaat account and associated data (Google Play Store & App Store compliance).
accountDeletionStep1: 1. Open the PlayerHaat mobile app or sign in on the website and go to Settings → Account → Delete account.
accountDeletionStep2: 2. Confirm deletion (enter your password if your account uses email + password).
accountDeletionStep3: 3. Your profile, sport profiles, and uploaded photos are immediately purged and anonymized.
accountDeletionWhatIsDeletedBody: Your personal profile, phone number, email address, login links, avatar, uploaded match photos, video links, and sport profiles are permanently removed. Completed match ratings are anonymized so historical match integrity is preserved.
accountDeletionEmailFallback: If you cannot access your account, email support@playerhaat.com from your registered email or phone number with the subject 'DELETE ACCOUNT'.
